scripts.generate-assets: mkdir -p assets && rsvg-convert -w 1024 -h 1024 aistudio-elrc-maker/public/icon-app.svg -o assets/icon.png && rsvg-convert -w 2732 -h 2732 aistudio-elrc-maker/public/icon-app.svg -o assets/splash.png && npx @capacitor/assets generate --android
scripts.build:web: cd aistudio-elrc-maker && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npx cap sync
